extracted.intended_audience: peer reviewers and applicants for biomedical research grants (bone biology/osteoimmunology researchers and fellowship reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: A biomedical grant/fellowship research proposal describing Specific Aims, Significance, Innovation, and detailed Approach to study how Staphylococcus aureus alters osteoclastogenesis and bone remodeling using in vitro assays and mouse models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear primary objective and hypothesis
rubrics_metrics.description: The primary objective of this proposal is to define the mechanisms by which bacterial pathogens alter osteoclastogenesis to impact bone homeostasis and skeletal immunity. Overall, I hypothesize that S. aureus modulates OC precursor (pre-OC) cell biology and bone remodeling through ligation of OC PRRs and the induction of inflammation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific Aims should be integrated and explicitly state testable hypotheses linking bacterial sensing (TLRs/IL-1R/MyD88) to changes in OC differentiation, function, bacterial clearance, and bone remodeling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aim 1 — role of TLRs and IL-1R
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim 1: Define the role of TLRs and IL-1R in S. aureus-mediated perturbation of osteoclastogenesis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designs should characterize effects in primary BM cultures from WT and TLR2, TLR9, and IL-1R-deficient mice, with and without RANKL, using bacterial components, TLR agonists, or recombinant IL-1 to (i) identify changes in expression of TLRs and factors known to modulate osteoclastogenesis, (ii) define activation status of intracellular signaling cascades and TFs, and (iii) investigate OC functionality with bone resorption assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aim 2 — skeletal cell-specific MyD88 signaling
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim 2: Elucidate the role of skeletal cell-specific MyD88 signaling on pathogen clearance and bone remodeling during S. aureus osteomyelitis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create skeletal cell-specific MyD88 knockout mice (Cre-Lox) to test effects on kinetics of pathogen clearance, dissemination to other organs, microCT-based bone remodeling changes, and histological quantification of osteoclasts in vivo.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance — disease burden and translational impact
rubrics_metrics.description: A1. Staphylococcus aureus is the most common cause of bacterial bone infection (osteomyelitis)... These studies have the potential to significantly impact human health by identifying therapeutic targets to limit bone destruction during osteomyelitis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should justify clinical importance (prevalence, complications, treatment gaps) and how mechanistic findings could identify therapeutic targets or broader principles linking infection/inflammation to bone loss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation — use of primary cells and relevant strains
rubrics_metrics.description: B1. The effects of S. aureus on bone at the cellular and organ level could describe common processes... We plan to use primary cell culture models of both whole bone marrow (WBM) and bone marrow macrophages (BMMs) and a clinically relevant isolate of S. aureus (LAC, a USA300-type strain).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for primary cells over cell lines, use of clinically relevant bacterial strains, novel genetic mouse models, and functional readouts where prior literature mostly provided phenotypic data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of both WBM and BMM cultures
rubrics_metrics.description: Use primary cell culture models of both whole bone marrow (WBM) and bone marrow macrophages (BMMs) to explore differences in cellular stimulation rather than limiting to one BM culture condition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare osteoclastogenic outcomes across culture systems to reveal disparities at gene and protein expression levels; avoid over-reliance on immortalized/line cells.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and phenotyping of osteoclasts (OC)
rubrics_metrics.description: OC defined as TRAP-positive cells with 3 or more nuclei present. Mature OC genes: CTSK, ACP5, CTR, DCST2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantify TRAP-positive multinucleated cells and complement phenotyping with functional assays (resorption) and marker expression (qRT-PCR/Western) to distinguish canonical vs non-canonical OC-like cells.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functional readouts of OC activity
rubrics_metrics.description: Functional ability of TRAP-positive, multinucleated cells to resorb bone will be assessed by differentiating BM cultures on dentin chips and measuring soluble cross-linked type I collagen peptides (Ctx-1) by ELISA and formation of resorption pits (toluidine blue staining).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both biochemical (Ctx-1 ELISA) and morphologic (resorption pits) functional assays; confirm that TRAP-positive cells are functionally resorbing, not only phenotypically OC-like.

rubrics_metrics.name: Experimental controls for osteoclastogenesis assays
rubrics_metrics.description: BM cultures treated with M-CSF (negative control) will monitor baseline osteoclastogenic phenotypes, whereas BM cultures stimulated with M-CSF and RANKL (positive control) will monitor normal OC differentiation in vitro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always include appropriate negative and positive controls (M-CSF only and M-CSF+RANKL) and vehicle controls when testing bacterial supernatants, TLR agonists, or recombinant cytokines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of genetic loss-of-function models and relevant knockouts
rubrics_metrics.description: Use mice deficient in MyD88, TLR2, TLR9, IL-1R, and potentially NOD receptors or other IL-1 family cytokine-deficient mice; create skeletal cell-specific MyD88 knockouts using Osteocalcin-cre and Cathepsin K-cre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage global and cell-specific knockouts to dissect signaling pathways; plan backup strategies (alternate cre lines, BM transplants) when cell-specific models have limitations or off-target deletions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choice of clinically relevant bacterial strain
rubrics_metrics.description: Use an isolate of S. aureus (LAC, a USA300-type strain) that represents the most common lineage causing bone infections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer clinical isolates over laboratory/regional strains to improve relevance and clarify discrepancies in prior studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantitative microCT endpoints for bone remodeling
rubrics_metrics.description: To quantify bone remodeling, microCT will be used to measure cortical bone changes and trabecular architecture, including bone volume/trabecular volume (BV/TV), trabecular thickness, trabecular spacing, and trabecular number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use standardized, quantitative imaging endpoints (BV/TV, thickness, spacing, number) and compare infected vs mock-infected bones from the same mouse strain when feasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Histologic quantification of OCs in vivo
rubrics_metrics.description: Femurs will be decalcified and embedded for sectioning and staining with bone-specific H&E and TRAP stains. OCs will be quantified by counting TRAP-positive MNCs next to trabeculae in infected or mock-infected femurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine imaging (microCT) with histology and quantification of TRAP-positive multinucleated cells to support conclusions about OC number and activity in vivo.

rubrics_metrics.name: In vivo infection outcome measures — CFU enumeration and dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerate S. aureus CFUs present at the primary infection site and distant organs (femur, kidneys, liver) and monitor mortality curves to assess ability to control infection and dissemination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use precise CFU calculations, multiple organs, and appropriate time-points (e.g., day 14) to link immune signaling perturbations to bacterial burden and survival outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Molecular assays for receptor/transcript and signaling activation
rubrics_metrics.description: Isolate RNA during osteoclastogenesis assays and use qRT-PCR to measure transcripts (RANKL, OPG, RANK, c-Fms, OSCAR, TREM2, LGR4). Analyze activation of signaling components using Western blot detection of activated proteins (PLC-γ, p38, IκBα, cFos) with phospho-specific antibodies and nuclear fractionation to detect translocated NFATc1 and c-Jun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform time-course RNA/protein assays to map receptor expression and signaling changes; follow up mRNA findings with protein-level validation (Western blot) when mRNA remains constant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish OC differentiation from alternative myeloid fates
rubrics_metrics.description: To rule out differentiation toward other myeloid cell lineages, test for M1 and M2 macrophage differentiation by measuring nos2 and arg1 mRNA expression, respectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include lineage marker assays to ensure observed TRAP-positive or multinucleated cells are following OC lineage rather than macrophage polarization or other fates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipated results, troubleshooting, and alternative approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: If no bone resorption is seen in 7-day assays, lengthen assays to 14–21 days; if select TLR- or IL-1R-deficient mice lack robust phenotypes, test NOD receptors or other cytokine-deficient mice; add recombinant IL-1R antagonist; perform BM transplants; use scaffolds eluting heat-killed bacteria or concentrated supernatants to control for high bacterial burdens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should include realistic alternative strategies and contingency plans for negative or ambiguous results, assay duration adjustments, and additional mutant strains or experimental setups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantification methods and replication
rubrics_metrics.description: TRAP-positive multinucleated cells were quantified manually in triplicate; OsteoMeasure software in the Vanderbilt Center for Bone Biology will be used for quantification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify quantification software/tools and replicate counts (e.g., triplicates), and report statistical significance (p-values) to support claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calvarial injection model and dynamic histomorphometry
rubrics_metrics.description: Calvarial injection of concentrated S. aureus supernatants or vehicle for 5 days; quantify resorption pits by microCT after 9 days and measure mineral apposition rate (MAR) and bone formation rate (BFR) using calcein fluorescent double labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use local delivery models and dynamic labeling to assess bone formation/resorption rates in vivo as complementary functional assays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of preliminary data and institutional resources
rubrics_metrics.description: C1 Preliminary studies demonstrating S. aureus modulation of OC differentiation and MyD88 importance in vivo; B2 Novel genetic mouse models and access to VUIIS and VCBB facilities with letters of support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include strong preliminary data and institutional core facility support/letters to demonstrate feasibility and access to necessary imaging and analysis resources.
